what: Same five-cycle counter, but every carry level is observable: each N1 wrap prints 'T' except when the carry cascades further; the final wrap prints 'Z' and halts. Output length equals the number of N1 wraps (6561 = 3^8).
claim: PROGRESS_MARKERS_PER_WRAP=DEMONSTRATED: the counter emits one marker per N1 wrap; a host consuming the stream can count wraps exactly.
